text.p: These were the main headlines from Lithuania's M-1 plus radio station's news report on Thursday afternoon. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Lithuanian diplomats said that as of this morning they had not yet received official confirmation of the visit of the U.S. Secretary of State Madeleine Albright to Vilnius expected next Sunday.
- The Lithuanian parliament unanimously passed a decision that presidential elections will be held on December 21.

- The parliament decided to allow prisoners to wear their own clothes instead of prison uniforms. The rule will not be applied to prisoners who committed very serious crimes and those who are serving life sentences.
